question: Any trials for GERD?
answer:
Found 5 clinical trial records for GERD: Famotidine in Subjects With Non-erosive Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease [3], Efficacy of Pantoprazole in Patients Older Than 18 Years Who Have Symptoms of Acid Reflux (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease) (BY1023/M3-339) [4], Natural History of Gastroesophageal Reflux (GER) in Children and Adolescents [5], On Demand Treatment of Reflux Disease [6] and Treatment Of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease By Endoscopic Fundoplication, A Placebo-Controlled Study [7]. 
Multiple PubMed publications review GERD as a motility disorder causing heartburn and regurgitation, most effectively treated with proton-pump inhibitors, whose long-term use carries risks including bone fractures, renal disease, pneumonia, and Clostridium difficile infection [1]. In children, GER is often physiologic, whereas GERD is a less common pathologic process involving impaired mucosal defense, motility defects, and anatomical abnormalities such as hiatal hernia [2].
